text: Collectible Concepts Group, Inc. ("CCGI") and Pivotal Self Service Tech, Inc. ("PVSS")
The Joint Venture shall commence on the 1st of March, 2003
the construction and interpretation of the terms and provisions of this Agreement shall be interpreted and construed under the laws of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania
All income and credits, and all losses and deductions shall be owned and shared among the Joint Venturers as follows:
If requested by a Joint Venturer, the Joint Venture books and records shall be audited as of the close of each year by an independent accountant acceptable to both Joint Venturers.

No Joint Venturer shall be authorized or empowered to mortgage, hypothecate, pledge, sell, or transfer, an interest in the Joint Venture, nor confer on any successor or assignee the right to become a Joint Venturer without the consent of the other Joint Venturer.

On any termination of the Joint Venture, its debt shall be paid or provided for in a manner satisfactory to the Joint Venturers. Then, any unexpended portion of Joint Venture funds shall be distributed to the Joint Venturers in accordance with their prorata ownership in the Joint Venture and all other assets of the Joint Venture shall be distributed as undivided interests to the Joint Venturers ratably according to their prorata interests in the Joint Venture as set forth in Section 6.
